_comment: Database structures of builds whose encrypted backups restore has been verified against. A snapshot must match one of them exactly (tables and their columns) for its schema version; the running build's own structure is computed at runtime. Generated by running init_db of each build on an empty database. A build may also list strict_tables: the detailed structure of selected tables (columns with type, NOT NULL, default, primary key and hidden flag; unique indexes with collation; foreign keys; every CHECK rule as a token sequence with its owner; every column definition in full (COLLATE, DEFAULT, GENERATED); the whole CREATE TABLE as a token sequence; the outcome of write probes run on a scratch copy of the table (values differing only in case among them); table options; explicit index SQL; every trigger on or referring to the table), which must match as well; for portal-a3fbe00 it was taken from init_db of a3fbe00 on an empty database.

builds.source: fix/wp22-medical-integrity commit de128d4 (WP2.2-A); identical v20 structure in fix/patient-event-integrity commit 19a22b4 (WP2.1)
fix/wp23-consilium-scheduling-integrity commit efe7168 (WP2.3-A); identical v21 structure in fix/wp22-consilium-decision commit 7d114ac (WP2.2-B)

fix/wp23b3-consilium-backdating commit bd75612 (WP2.3-B3); identical v22 structure in fix/wp23b1-consilium-history commit 15b8266 (WP2.3-B1) and fix/wp23b2-consilium-scheduling-rbac commit 9b0edbc (WP2.3-B2)
feat/executive-dashboard-redesign commit a3fbe00 (Patient Portal stage 1, schema v10 = v9 + patient_portal_access)
